extDescription.en: Chrome side panel that embeds the local DeepSeek Harness agent GUI and attaches the current page to it.
extDescription.zh_CN: 把本地 DeepSeek Harness agent 嵌进浏览器侧边栏，并把当前网页交给它。

hintStartDsh.en:
$1

Hint: start `dsh web` first (or install the native host so it can auto-start), then click “Retry”.
hintStartDsh.zh_CN:
$1

提示：先启动 dsh web（或安装 native host 后自动拉起），再点“重试”。

gatePermissionBody.en: A one-time grant is needed to read the text and screenshots of any web page. Everything stays on this machine (written into your workspace and handed to your local DSH) — nothing goes to any service outside this extension.
gatePermissionBody.zh_CN: 需要一次性授权，才能读取任意网页的正文与截图。内容只在本机处理（写入工作区 + 交给本地 DSH），不会经过本扩展外的任何服务。

statusNotGranted.en: Not granted yet: click the extension icon once on the target page (that grants the tab temporarily), then retry.
statusNotGranted.zh_CN: 未授权：可在目标网页点一次扩展图标（临时授权）后重试

statusBrowserControlOn.en: Browser control is on: clicks and typing use real input events (Chrome shows a “being debugged” banner while it runs).
statusBrowserControlOn.zh_CN: 浏览器控制已开启：点击/输入走真实输入事件（浏览器会显示「正在调试」横幅）

statusBrowserControlOff.en: Browser control is off: the debugger was released.
statusBrowserControlOff.zh_CN: 浏览器控制已关闭：已释放调试器

statusWriteOpsOn.en: Write actions are on: the model can see $1 browser tools ($2).
statusWriteOpsOn.zh_CN: 写操作已开启：模型可见 $1 个浏览器工具（$2）

statusWriteOpsOff.en: Write actions are off: the model only has read-only tools.
statusWriteOpsOff.zh_CN: 写操作已关闭：模型只剩只读工具

gateAsk.en: Every click and typing first asks for approval (per the default policy; a session set to “never” is refused outright).
gateAsk.zh_CN: 每次点击/输入都会先请求批准（按默认策略；某会话若被设为 never，会被当场拒绝）

gateNoApprovalService.en: This deployment has no approval service: only this switch gates write access.
gateNoApprovalService.zh_CN: 本部署无审批服务：仅由这个开关把关

gatePolicyNever.en: Approval policy is “never”: no prompt appears and write actions are refused outright (set the policy back to “ask” first).
gatePolicyNever.zh_CN: 审批策略是 never：不会弹提示，写操作会被直接拒绝（先把策略改回 ask）

gateApprovalOff.en: Approval is disabled in the configuration.

attachPageTitle.zh_CN: Attach 当前网页（整页 Markdown）

browserControlTitle.en: Uses the DevTools protocol to send real input events (trusted click/type, full-page screenshots, accessibility tree). While it is on, Chrome shows a “being debugged” banner.
browserControlTitle.zh_CN: 开启后用 DevTools 协议发送真实输入事件（可信点击/输入、整页截图、无障碍树）。开启期间浏览器会显示「正在调试」横幅。

writeOpsTitle.en: Lets the agent click, type and navigate in your pages (browser_click / browser_type / browser_navigate). Off by default — these tools are only registered for the model after you turn it on.
writeOpsTitle.zh_CN: 允许 Agent 在你的页面上点击/输入/导航（browser_click / browser_type / browser_navigate）。默认关闭；开启后这些工具才会被注册给模型。

errNoHostPermission.en: This page is not authorized yet: click “Grant & capture” to grant “read all websites” once, or click the extension icon on the target page (that grants the tab temporarily) and retry.
errNoHostPermission.zh_CN: 当前网页未获授权：请点「授权并抓取」授予一次「读取所有网站」权限；或在目标网页上点一次扩展图标（临时授权该标签页）后重试。

errNoSelection.en: No selection detected: select some text on the page first, then click “Attach selection” — or use “Attach page” to capture the whole page.
errNoSelection.zh_CN: 没有检测到选区：请先在网页上划选文字再点「Attach 选区」，或改用「Attach 网页」抓整页。

errDshDown.en: The local DSH is not running: start it with `dsh web`.
errDshDown.zh_CN: 本地 DSH 未运行：请先启动 dsh web。

errReadonly.en: This action needs write access: turn on the “Write actions” switch in the panel (only then are the click/type/navigate tools registered for the model).
errReadonly.zh_CN: 这次操作需要写权限：请在面板打开「写操作」开关（模型侧才会注册点击/输入/导航工具）。

errExtOffline.en: The browser extension is not connected: open the side panel (the /ag/agent channel only exists while the panel is open).
errExtOffline.zh_CN: 浏览器扩展没有连上：请打开侧边栏面板（面板打开时才会建立 /ag/agent 通道）。

errTargetBusy.en: The target tab is held by another debugger (usually another extension debugging that page): close that debugger and retry.
errTargetBusy.zh_CN: 目标标签页已被另一个调试器占用（通常是另一个扩展在调试该页）：关掉那个调试器再试。

errTimeout.en: Timed out: $1. The page may still be loading; try again in a moment.
errTimeout.zh_CN: 操作超时：$1。页面可能仍在加载，可稍后重试。

shotNoImage.en: Screenshot failed: the extension got no image at all (the page text was still delivered).
shotNoImage.zh_CN: 截图没成功：扩展没有取到任何图像（正文已照常投递）。

shotFailedWithReason.en: Screenshot failed; the page text was still delivered: $1
shotFailedWithReason.zh_CN: 截图没成功，正文已照常投递：$1

shotEmptyImage.en: Screenshot failed: the image was empty (the page text was still delivered).
shotEmptyImage.zh_CN: 截图没成功：图像是空的（正文已照常投递）。

dshDownNoNativeHost.en: DSH is not running and the native host is not installed. Run `node native-host/install.mjs` first, or start `dsh web` manually.
dshDownNoNativeHost.zh_CN: DSH 未运行，且未安装 native host。请先运行：node native-host/install.mjs，或手动启动 dsh web。

dshAutoStartFailed.en: DSH is not running and auto-start failed: $1
dshAutoStartFailed.zh_CN: DSH 未运行且自动拉起失败：$1

errNotPaired.en: The extension and the plugin are not paired yet — run `node scripts/init-key.mjs` and reload the extension.
errNotPaired.zh_CN: 扩展与插件尚未配对 —— 请运行 `node scripts/init-key.mjs`，然后重新加载扩展。

errTicketFailed.en:
Could not get a one-time entry ticket ($1): $2

Automatic entry was stopped so that the long-lived key never enters the iframe URL. Reopen the side panel to retry; if it keeps failing, run `node scripts/init-key.mjs` and reload the extension.
errTicketFailed.zh_CN:
取一次性进入票据失败（$1）：$2

为不把长期密钥写进 iframe URL，已停止自动进入。请重开侧边栏重试；若持续失败，运行 node scripts/init-key.mjs 后重新加载扩展。
